datasets.name: ERA5
datasets.producer: ECMWF for the Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S)
datasets.coverage: Global; January 1940 to near present; hourly; 0.25° on the Climate Data Store
datasets.about: The most widely used global reanalysis. Near-real-time data (ERA5T) can be revised if a production problem is found.

datasets.name: MERRA-2
datasets.full_name: Modern-Era Retrospective analysis for Research and Applications, Version 2
datasets.variables: Atmosphere, aerosols, land surface; corrected precipitation (PRECTOTCORR) forced by gauge analyses
datasets.producer: NASA Global Modeling and Assimilation Office (GMAO); distributed by GES DISC
datasets.about: NASA's global reanalysis. Land precipitation seen by the land model (PRECTOTCORR) is corrected towards gauge-based analyses, so changes in those analyses can pass into MERRA-2.
datasets.known_issues_note: We did not find a public known-issues list for MERRA-2 (checked 22 Nov 2026). GMAO takes reports through its diagnostic feedback page.

datasets.name: CPC Unified Gauge Analysis
datasets.full_name: CPC Unified Gauge-Based Analysis of Global Daily Precipitation
datasets.variables: Daily precipitation and number of gauges per cell
datasets.producer: NOAA Climate Prediction Center (CPC); distributed by NOAA PSL
datasets.about: Daily gauge analysis built by optimal interpolation. The retrospective period uses more than 30,000 gauges and the real-time version about 17,000. Quality varies with gauge density, and the files carry the gauge count for each cell. MERRA-2 uses it to correct the precipitation that reaches its land surface.
links: Chen et al. (2008), the gauge analysis method
datasets.known_issues_label: NOAA PSL data notices (all PSL datasets)
datasets.contact: NOAA CPC / PSL (see the dataset page)

datasets.name: GPCC Monthly
datasets.variables: Monthly land precipitation and number of gauges per cell
datasets.producer: Global Precipitation Climatology Centre (GPCC), Deutscher Wetterdienst
datasets.version: Version 2025 (successor of Full Data Monthly V2022; now merged with the former Monitoring Product)
datasets.about: The main global monthly gauge analysis. It is also the gauge input to GPCP and to the IMERG Final Run.
links: GPCC Monthly V2025 DOI and download page
datasets.known_issues_note: We did not find a dedicated known-issues page for GPCC (checked 22 Nov 2026).

datasets.name: GPCP Monthly
datasets.full_name: Global Precipitation Climatology Project (GPCP) Monthly Climate Data Record, Version 2.3
datasets.producer: GPCP (University of Maryland / NASA GSFC) for the NOAA Climate Data Record program
datasets.coverage: Global land and ocean; January 1979 to present; monthly; 2.5°
datasets.about: Merges passive-microwave and infrared satellite estimates with GPCC gauge analyses over land.
datasets.known_issues_note: We did not find a known-issues page for GPCP v2.3 (checked 22 Nov 2026).

datasets.name: IMERG
datasets.full_name: Integrated Multi-satellitE Retrievals for GPM (IMERG), Version 07
datasets.producer: NASA Global Precipitation Measurement (GPM) mission; distributed by GES DISC
datasets.coverage: Global; TRMM and GPM eras; half-hourly; 0.1°
datasets.about: The US multi-satellite precipitation product. The Final Run is adjusted to a monthly satellite–gauge combination that uses the GPCC gauge analysis.
datasets.known_issues_note: The V07 release notes describe known problems and the V07B reprocessing; the GES DISC dataset pages also list data anomalies.

datasets.name: E-OBS
datasets.full_name: E-OBS daily gridded observational dataset for Europe
datasets.variables: Daily temperature (mean, min, max), precipitation, pressure, humidity, wind, radiation
datasets.producer: KNMI / ECA&D for the Copernicus Climate Change Service
datasets.coverage: Europe; 1950 to present; daily; 0.1° and 0.25°; 20-member ensemble
datasets.about: Gridded from ECA&D station series. Full versions come out twice a year with provisional monthly updates. Station coverage can change between versions, which can leave gaps or steps in recent years.
links: Daily, monthly and full updates explained
Cornes et al. (2018), the ensemble version

datasets.name: ICOADS
datasets.full_name: International Comprehensive Ocean-Atmosphere Data Set, Release 3
datasets.variables: Individual ship, buoy and platform reports: SST, air temperature, wind, pressure, humidity, cloud
datasets.producer: NOAA NCEI, NCAR, NOC Southampton and partners
datasets.version: R3.0.0 (1662–2014), R3.1.0 (with subsidiary records), near-real-time R3.0.2 (2015 onwards)
datasets.coverage: Global oceans; 1662 to present; individual reports
datasets.about: The archive of marine surface reports behind HadSST, ERSST and other SST and marine products.
datasets.known_issues_note: We did not find a known-issues list for ICOADS Release 3 (checked 22 Nov 2026).

datasets.name: HadSST4
datasets.full_name: Met Office Hadley Centre Sea-Surface Temperature dataset, HadSST.4.2.0.0
datasets.variables: Monthly SST anomalies with a 200-member bias ensemble and uncertainty estimates
datasets.coverage: Global oceans; January 1850 to present; monthly; 5°
datasets.about: In situ SST anomalies with bias adjustments, used in HadCRUT5. Inputs are ICOADS 3.0.0 (1850–2014) and 3.0.1 (2015–2021), then Met Office GTS ship data and iQuam moored-buoy data.
datasets.known_issues_note: We did not find a known-issues page for HadSST4 (checked 22 Nov 2026).

datasets.name: OISST v2.1
datasets.full_name: NOAA 0.25° Daily Optimum Interpolation Sea Surface Temperature (OISST), Version 2.1
datasets.variables: Daily SST, anomalies, error estimate, sea-ice concentration
datasets.producer: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI)
datasets.coverage: Global oceans; September 1981 to present; daily; 0.25°
datasets.about: Blends satellite (AVHRR) and in situ SST. Widely used for marine heatwave studies.
datasets.known_issues_note: We did not find a known-issues page for OISST v2.1 (checked 22 Nov 2026).

datasets.name: IBTrACS
datasets.full_name: International Best Track Archive for Climate Stewardship, Version 4 (v04r01)
datasets.variables: Storm position, intensity and size from all warning agencies
datasets.producer: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI)
datasets.about: Combines best tracks from the warning agencies worldwide. Recent storms are provisional and can change.
datasets.known_issues_note: Caveats are in the technical documentation; bug fixes are recorded in the v04r01 change log on the NCEI page.

datasets.name: COOP Hourly Precipitation (HPD)
datasets.full_name: NOAA Cooperative Observer Program (COOP) Precipitation Data – Hourly, Version 2 (C-HPD)
datasets.producer: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI)
datasets.coverage: United States and territories; about 2,000 stations; 1940 to present
datasets.about: Fischer & Porter gauges of the COOP network. Between 2004 and 2013 the stations were upgraded from paper punch tape to electronic data loggers.
links: Lawrimore et al. (2020), processing and QC
datasets.known_issues_note: We did not find a known-issues page for HPD v2 (checked 22 Nov 2026).

datasets.name: ASOS
datasets.variables: Wind, temperature, dew point, pressure, precipitation, visibility, sky condition
datasets.producer: NWS, FAA and Department of Defense; archived by NOAA NCEI
datasets.coverage: United States; about 950 mostly airport stations; 1990s to present
datasets.about: The main US automated airport network, used in station climate records such as HadISD. Sensor replacements show up as steps in long series.
datasets.known_issues_note: There is no single known-issues list for ASOS climate series; sensor-change dates come from NWS and station metadata.
datasets.contact: See the NWS ASOS program page

datasets.name: GHCN-CAMS
datasets.producer: NOAA Climate Prediction Center (CPC); distributed by NOAA PSL
datasets.about: Combines GHCN and CAMS station data with lapse-rate topographic adjustment, so it can be updated in near real time.
datasets.known_issues_label: NOAA PSL data notices (all PSL datasets)
datasets.contact: NOAA CPC / PSL (see the dataset page)
